tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring e-cigarette on a plane?

travelTips: E-cigarettes and vape devices must travel in carry-on baggage or on your person. Do not charge or use them on board.

faq.question: Is e-cigarette allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: E-Cigarette is allowed in carry-on luggage. E-cigarettes and vape devices must travel in carry-on baggage or on your person. Do not charge or use them on board.

faq.question: Can you pack e-cigarette in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, E-Cigarette is not allowed in checked bags. E-cigarettes are prohibited in checked baggage holds due to FAA fire hazard regulations.
